newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Home Q4 shr rises to $1.07.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Home Q4 shr rises to $1.07.

text.p: Note (a) - With the completion of the 1997 business plan in the fourth quarter of 1996, the company completed its annual evaluation of intended use of its land inventories to insure that use of inventories is consistent with market conditions. As a result, the intended use of certain land inventories was changed. Base on the new intended use, the company performed impairment test and determined the cost of the land had been impaired and, accordingly, recorded a non-cash provision for impairment of $13.0 million ($8.2 million, net of tax).

Note (b) - During the fourth quarter of 1996, the Internal Revenue Service completed an examination of the company's federal income tax returns for the years ended December 31, 1993 and 1992. The examination results allowed certain previously reserved deductions taken in the company's 1993 tax return and, at the conclusion of the examination, the company reduced its deferred tax liability and recognized an income tax benefit totaling $8.7 million related to the deductions.

Note (c) - Weighted average number of common and common equivalent shares outstanding for primary income per share include the dilutive effect of the convertible redeemable preferred stock and Class B warrants and the assumed exercise of stock options. Fully diluted income per share includes the assumed conversion of the convertible subordinated debentures.
Note (d) - The company capitalized interest cost into housing inventories and charges the previously capitalized interest to interest expense when the related inventories are delivered.
Full name of company is U.S. Home Corporation.
